soldier: Head brown tinged with red, thorax and abdomen brown. Head subrectangular, length about 1.2 to 1.3 times the width, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded, fontanelle at the midpoint; in lateral view the dorsal margin of the head slightly arched at the fontanelle, the postmentum slightly projecting. Labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip triangular. Mandibles stout, about half the head capsule in length, the apex slightly curved; the anterior part of the inner margin of the left mandible with scattered fine teeth, three incisions behind the midpoint. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segments 2 and 4 nearly equal; compound eyes small, dot-like and distinctly projecting. Postmentum about 3.5 times its width, the waist region near the middle. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both distinctly incised in the middle; mesonotum and metanotum both narrower than the pronotum, the angular extension of their lateral lobes very inconspicuous.
